# H1: Response Latency

## Model 1

Logged response latency on treatment, logged baseline speed, survey duration and survey date fixed effects (Table C.1).

```{r m_time}
m_time_full_federal <- lm(t_list_votes_exp_Page_Submit_log ~ treatment + baseline_speed + duration + lead_time,
  data = data_federal_time_main_nooutliers
)
summary(m_time_full_federal)
```

Predicted latencies in seconds (Rittmann et al. 2025) for an average case:
baseline speed and duration at their means, lead time of 15 days.

```{r time_simulation}
scenario_means_federal <- data_federal_time_main_nooutliers %>%
  summarize(baseline_speed = mean(baseline_speed), duration = mean(duration))
scenario_means_federal

set.seed(20250223)
m_time_full_federal_avg_case_sim <- simloglm(m_time_full_federal, scenario = list(
  treatment = c("Control", "Treatment (5)", "Treatment (500)"),
  baseline_speed = scenario_means_federal$baseline_speed,
  duration = scenario_means_federal$duration,
  lead_time = "15"
))

# Scenario pairs of the first differences, in plot order
time_diffs_federal <- list("T(500) - T(5)" = c(2, 3), "T(5) - C" = c(1, 2), "T(500) - C" = c(1, 3))
```

## Figure 2: Conditional Median

```{r figure_2}
time_median_federal <- compute_time_effects(m_time_full_federal_avg_case_sim, "median", time_diffs_federal) # helper

plot_time_median_federal <- plot_time_pred( # helper
  create_time_pred_data(time_median_federal$summary, "Cond. Median", election = "federal"), # helper
  stat = "Cond. Median", election = "federal",
  x_limits = x_limits_time_median, x_breaks = x_breaks_time_median
)
plot_time_median_federal
save_figure(plot_time_median_federal, "figure_2a_h1_median_federal",
  election = "federal", # helper
  width = "subfigure", aspect = 1 / 2
)

plot_time_median_fd_federal <- plot_time_diff( # helper
  create_time_diff_data(time_median_federal$diff, "FD Median"), # helper
  stat = "FD Median", election = "federal",
  names_vec = names(time_diffs_federal),
  x_limits = x_limits_time_fd_median, x_breaks = x_breaks_time_fd_median
)
plot_time_median_fd_federal
save_figure(plot_time_median_fd_federal, "figure_2b_h1_median_fd_federal",
  election = "federal", # helper
  width = "subfigure", aspect = 1 / 2
)
```

```{r values_figure_2}
create_time_pred_data(time_median_federal$summary, "Cond. Median", election = "federal") %>% print_values(digits = 1) # helper
create_time_diff_data(time_median_federal$diff, "FD Median") %>% print_values(digits = 1) # helper
```

# H2: Overall Accuracy

## Model 2a: MAE (Figure 3)

Individual MAE and RMSE (paper section Modeling and appendix section Plots Robustness Checks).

```{r mae_descriptives}
data_federal_main %>%
  summarize(across(
    c(list_votes_exp_mae, list_votes_exp_rmse),
    list(min = min, mean = mean, sd = sd, max = max)
  )) %>%
  print_values(digits = 2) # helper
```

```{r m_mae}
m_mae_full_federal <- lm(list_votes_exp_mae ~ treatment + lead_time, data = data_federal_main)
summary(m_mae_full_federal)

mae_federal <- compute_treatment_effects(m_mae_full_federal, data_federal_main) # helper
```

```{r figure_3}
plot_mae_federal <- plot_accuracy_pred(mae_federal$pred, "Average Predicted MAE\n(with 95% CI)", # helper
  y_limits = c(4.2, 5.1), y_breaks = seq(4.2, 5.1, by = 0.1),
  election = "federal"
)
plot_mae_federal
save_figure(plot_mae_federal, "figure_3a_h2_mae_federal",
  election = "federal", # helper
  width = "subfigure", aspect = 1 / 2
)

plot_mae_fd_federal <- plot_accuracy_diff(mae_federal$diff, "Difference in Average Predicted MAE\n(with 95% CI)", # helper
  y_limits = c(-0.5, 0), y_breaks = seq(-0.5, 0, by = 0.1),
  election = "federal"
)
plot_mae_fd_federal
save_figure(plot_mae_fd_federal, "figure_3b_h2_mae_fd_federal",
  election = "federal", # helper
  width = "subfigure", aspect = 1 / 2
)
```

```{r values_figure_3}
print_values(mae_federal$pred, c("treatment", est_cols)) # helper
print_values(mae_federal$diff, c("diff", est_cols)) # helper
```

## Heterogeneity by Education (Figure C.9)

MAE on treatment interacted with educational attainment.

```{r m_mae_educ}
data_federal_educ_main <- data_federal_main %>%
  filter(!is.na(education_eng), education_eng != "Still in School") %>%
  mutate(education_eng = droplevels(factor(education_eng, levels = c("High", "Medium", "Low"))))

m_mae_educ_federal <- lm(list_votes_exp_mae ~ treatment * education_eng + lead_time,
  data = data_federal_educ_main
)
summary(m_mae_educ_federal)
count_model_n(m_mae_educ_federal, data_federal_educ_main) # helper

mae_educ_federal <- compute_treatment_effects(m_mae_educ_federal, data_federal_educ_main, by = "education_eng") # helper
mae_educ_federal$pred <- mae_educ_federal$pred %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor_groups_federal(treatment)) # helper
mae_educ_federal$diff <- mae_educ_federal$diff %>%
  mutate(education_eng = factor(education_eng, levels = c("High", "Medium", "Low")))
```

```{r figure_C9}
plot_mae_educ_federal <- plot_by_moderator( # helper
  mae_educ_federal$pred, "education_eng", "Education", "Average Predicted MAE\n(with 95% CI)",
  election = "federal", y_limits = c(3, 6.1), y_breaks = seq(3, 6.5, by = 0.5)
)
plot_mae_educ_federal
save_figure(plot_mae_educ_federal, "figure_C9a_h2_mae_educ_federal",
  election = "federal", # helper
  width = "subfigure", aspect = 5 / 8
)

plot_mae_educ_fd_federal <- plot_by_moderator( # helper
  mae_educ_federal$diff, "education_eng", "Education", "Difference in Average Predicted MAE\n(with 95% CI)",
  election = "federal", diff = TRUE, y_limits = c(-1.2, 0.4), y_breaks = round(seq(-1.2, 0.4, by = 0.4), 1)
)
plot_mae_educ_fd_federal
save_figure(plot_mae_educ_fd_federal, "figure_C9b_h2_mae_educ_fd_federal",
  election = "federal", # helper
  width = "subfigure", aspect = 5 / 8
)
```

```{r values_figure_C9}
print_values(mae_educ_federal$diff, c("education_eng", "diff", est_cols)) # helper
```

## Heterogeneity by Political Interest (Figure C.10)

```{r m_mae_polint}
pol_interest_levels_federal <- c("Sehr stark", "Stark", "Mittelmäßig", "Weniger stark", "Überhaupt nicht")

data_federal_polint_main <- data_federal_main %>%
  filter(!is.na(pol_interest)) %>%
  mutate(pol_interest = recode_pol_interest(pol_interest, pol_interest_levels_federal)) # helper

m_mae_polint_federal <- lm(list_votes_exp_mae ~ treatment * pol_interest + lead_time,
  data = data_federal_polint_main
)
summary(m_mae_polint_federal)
count_model_n(m_mae_polint_federal, data_federal_polint_main) # helper

mae_polint_federal <- compute_treatment_effects(m_mae_polint_federal, data_federal_polint_main, by = "pol_interest") # helper
mae_polint_federal$pred <- mae_polint_federal$pred %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor_groups_federal(treatment)) # helper
mae_polint_federal$diff <- mae_polint_federal$diff %>%
  mutate(pol_interest = factor(pol_interest, levels = levels(data_federal_polint_main$pol_interest)))
```

```{r figure_C10}
plot_mae_polint_federal <- plot_by_moderator( # helper
  mae_polint_federal$pred, "pol_interest", "Political Interest", "Average Predicted MAE\n(with 95% CI)",
  election = "federal"
)
plot_mae_polint_federal
save_figure(plot_mae_polint_federal, "figure_C10a_h2_mae_polint_federal",
  election = "federal", # helper
  width = "subfigure", aspect = 5 / 8
)

plot_mae_polint_fd_federal <- plot_by_moderator( # helper
  mae_polint_federal$diff, "pol_interest", "Political Interest", "Difference in Average Predicted MAE\n(with 95% CI)",
  election = "federal", diff = TRUE
)
plot_mae_polint_fd_federal
save_figure(plot_mae_polint_fd_federal, "figure_C10b_h2_mae_polint_fd_federal",
  election = "federal", # helper
  width = "subfigure", aspect = 5 / 8
)
```


# H3: Wishful Thinking

## Wishful Thinking by Party (Figures 4 and B.7)

One model per party: forecast error on whether the party is the respondent's
preferred party (highest PTV).

```{r wt_byparty}
wt_byparty_ptv_federal <- fit_wt_by_party(data_federal_ptv_main, "preferred_party_ptv_dummy", # helper
  parties_7_federal,
  election = "federal"
)

plot_wt_byparty_federal <- plot_wt_by_party_pred(wt_byparty_ptv_federal$pred, election = "federal") # helper
plot_wt_byparty_federal
save_figure(plot_wt_byparty_federal, "figure_B7a_h3_wt_byparty_federal",
  election = "federal", # helper
  width = "subfigure", aspect = 6 / 8
)

plot_wt_byparty_fd_federal <- plot_wt_by_party_diff(wt_byparty_ptv_federal$diff, election = "federal") # helper
plot_wt_byparty_fd_federal
save_figure(plot_wt_byparty_fd_federal, "figure_4a_h3_wt_byparty_fd_federal",
  election = "federal", # helper
  width = "subfigure", aspect = 6 / 8
)
```

```{r values_figure_4}
print_values(wt_byparty_ptv_federal$pred, c("party", "preferred_party_dummy", est_cols)) # helper
print_values(wt_byparty_ptv_federal$diff, c("party", "diff", est_cols), digits = 1) # helper
```

## Model 3a: Preferred Party by PTV Dummy (Figure 5)

Forecast error on treatment interacted with the preferred-party dummy, with
survey date and party fixed effects. Standard errors are clustered by respondent.

```{r m_pref_ptv}
m_pref_ptv_federal <- lm(list_votes_exp_diff ~ treatment * preferred_party_ptv_dummy + lead_time + party,
  data = data_federal_ptv_main
)
lmtest::coeftest(m_pref_ptv_federal, vcov = sandwich::vcovCL(m_pref_ptv_federal, cluster = ~ResponseId))
count_model_n(m_pref_ptv_federal, data_federal_ptv_main) # helper

ptv_federal <- compute_treatment_effects(m_pref_ptv_federal, data_federal_ptv_main, # helper
  by = "preferred_party_ptv_dummy", vcov = ~ResponseId
)
```

```{r figure_5}
plot_pref_ptv_federal <- plot_wishful_thinking_pred(ptv_federal$pred, "preferred_party_ptv_dummy", # helper
  election = "federal"
)
plot_pref_ptv_federal
save_figure(plot_pref_ptv_federal, "figure_5a_h3_ptv_federal",
  election = "federal", # helper
  width = "subfigure", aspect = 1 / 2
)

plot_pref_ptv_fd_federal <- plot_wishful_thinking_diff(ptv_federal$diff, "preferred_party_ptv_dummy", # helper
  election = "federal",
  y_limits = c(-2.5, 0.5),
  y_breaks = seq(-2.5, 0.5, by = 0.5)
)
plot_pref_ptv_fd_federal
save_figure(plot_pref_ptv_fd_federal, "figure_5b_h3_ptv_fd_federal",
  election = "federal", # helper
  width = "subfigure", aspect = 1 / 2
)
```

```{r values_figure_5}
print_values(ptv_federal$pred, c("treatment", "preferred_party_ptv_dummy", est_cols)) # helper
print_values(ptv_federal$diff, c("diff", "preferred_party_ptv_dummy", est_cols)) # helper
```

## Model 3e: PTV Score (Figure C.6)

Forecast error on treatment interacted with the PTV score (1-11) of each
party.

```{r m_pref_ptv_score}

  data = data_federal_ptvscore_main
)
lmtest::coeftest(m_pref_ptv_score_federal, vcov = sandwich::vcovCL(m_pref_ptv_score_federal, cluster = ~ResponseId))
count_model_n(m_pref_ptv_score_federal, data_federal_ptvscore_main) # helper

ptv_score_federal <- compute_treatment_effects(m_pref_ptv_score_federal, data_federal_ptvscore_main, # helper
  by = "ptv_score", vcov = ~ResponseId
)
ptv_score_federal$pred <- ptv_score_federal$pred %>%
  mutate(treatment = recode_groups_federal(treatment)) # helper
```

```{r figure_C6}
plot_ptv_score_federal <- plot_ptv_score(ptv_score_federal$pred, election = "federal") # helper
plot_ptv_score_federal

  election = "federal", # helper
  width = "subfigure", aspect = 8 / 9
)

  width = "subfigure", aspect = 8 / 9
)
```

Values at PTV 1 and 11 (paper section Results, robustness checks).

```{r values_figure_C6}

  filter(ptv_score %in% c(1, 11)) %>%
  print_values(c("diff", "ptv_score", est_cols)) # helper
```

Lowest PTV score with a positive forecast error, by group.

```{r ptv_score_positive_error}
ptv_score_federal$pred %>%
  filter(estimate > 0) %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarize(first_positive_score = min(ptv_score))
```

## Heterogeneity by Education (Figure C.11)

Forecast error on treatment interacted with the preferred-party dummy (PTV)
and educational attainment.

```{r m_pref_ptv_educ}
data_federal_ptv_educ_main <- data_federal_ptv_main %>%
  left_join(data_federal_main %>% select(ResponseId, education_eng), by = "ResponseId") %>%
  filter(!is.na(education_eng), education_eng != "Still in School") %>%
  mutate(education_eng = droplevels(factor(education_eng, levels = c("Low", "Medium", "High"))))

m_pref_ptv_educ_federal <- lm(
  list_votes_exp_diff ~ treatment * preferred_party_ptv_dummy * education_eng + lead_time + party,
  data = data_federal_ptv_educ_main
)
count_model_n(m_pref_ptv_educ_federal, data_federal_ptv_educ_main) # helper

ptv_educ_federal <- compute_treatment_effects(m_pref_ptv_educ_federal, data_federal_ptv_educ_main, # helper
  by = c("preferred_party_ptv_dummy", "education_eng"), vcov = ~ResponseId
)
ptv_educ_federal$pred <- ptv_educ_federal$pred %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor_groups_federal(treatment), # helper
    preferred_party_ptv_dummy = factor(preferred_party_ptv_dummy, labels = pref_label)
  )
ptv_educ_federal$diff <- ptv_educ_federal$diff %>%
  mutate(
    education_eng = factor(education_eng, levels = c("Low", "Medium", "High")),
    preferred_party_ptv_dummy = factor(preferred_party_ptv_dummy, labels = pref_label)
  )
```

```{r figure_C11}

)
plot_ptv_educ_federal

)

)

save_figure(plot_ptv_educ_fd_federal, "figure_C11b_h3_ptv_educ_fd_federal",

)

```

# Robustness: Without Excluding Satisficers

## Who Was Excluded (Table C.3)

Share excluded by experimental group (paper section Data).

```{r exclusions_by_group}
data_federal_noexcl %>%
  transmute(treatment = as.character(treatment), excluded) %>%
  bind_rows(mutate(., treatment = "All")) %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), n_excluded = sum(excluded), share_excluded = mean(excluded), .groups = "drop") %>%
  print_values(digits = 4) # helper
```

```{r table_C3}
m_excl_logit_federal_demo <- glm(
  excluded ~ treatment + age_group + gender_eng2 + education_eng + turnout_int_dummy + bula_en,
  family = binomial,
  data = data_federal_noexcl
)
summary(m_excl_logit_federal_demo)

# Row labels and reference categories from the model
# State dummies as one fixed-effects row instead of one row per state
coef_names_excl_federal <- names(coef(m_excl_logit_federal_demo)) %>%
  str_subset("^bula_en", negate = TRUE)
coef_map_excl_federal <- coef_names_excl_federal %>%
  str_replace("^\\(Intercept\\)$", "Intercept") %>%
  str_replace("^treatmentTreatment \\(5\\)$", "T(5)") %>%
  str_replace("^treatmentTreatment \\(500\\)$", "T(500)") %>%
  str_replace("^age_group", "Age ") %>%
  str_replace("^gender_eng2", "Gender: ") %>%
  str_replace("^education_eng", "Education: ") %>%
  str_replace("^turnout_int_dummyja$", "Intends to Vote") %>%
  as.list() %>%
  set_names(coef_names_excl_federal)
ref_excl_federal <- m_excl_logit_federal_demo$xlevels

note_excl_logit_federal <- paste0(
  "Note: * p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001. Logistic regression of being excluded ",
  "(answered 50\\% for two parties) on treatment and respondent characteristics. ",
  "Reference categories: Control group, age ", ref_excl_federal$age_group[1],
  ", gender ", ref_excl_federal$gender_eng2[1], " (incl. diverse), education ",
  ref_excl_federal$education_eng[1], ", no turnout intention, state ", ref_excl_federal$bula_en[1], ". ",
  "The model includes fixed effects for the ", length(ref_excl_federal$bula_en), " federal states, ",
  "whose coefficients are not shown."
)

write_logit_table( # helper
  m_excl_logit_federal_demo,
  coef_map = coef_map_excl_federal,
  fe       = c("State Fixed Effects" = "bula_en"),
  caption  = "Logistic Regression of Being Excluded (Answered 50\\% Twice) on Treatment and Respondent Characteristics (Federal)",
  label    = "tab:excl_logit_federal",
  note     = note_excl_logit_federal,
  file     = "output/tables/table_C3_exclusions_logit_federal.tex"
)
```

## Models Without Exclusions (Table C.5)

All main models re-estimated on all first-time respondents. The response time
model still drops latency outliers (mean + 2 SD, computed in this sample).

```{r models_noexcl}
data_federal_time_noexcl_nooutliers <- data_federal_time_noexcl %>%
  filter(t_list_votes_exp_Page_Submit <= compute_time_cutoff(t_list_votes_exp_Page_Submit)) # helper

m_time_full_federal_noexcl <- lm(t_list_votes_exp_Page_Submit_log ~ treatment + baseline_speed + duration + lead_time,
  data = data_federal_time_noexcl_nooutliers
)
m_mae_full_federal_noexcl <- lm(list_votes_exp_mae ~ treatment + lead_time, data = data_federal_noexcl)
m_rmse_full_federal_noexcl <- lm(list_votes_exp_rmse ~ treatment + lead_time, data = data_federal_noexcl)
m_pref_ptv_federal_noexcl <- lm(list_votes_exp_diff ~ treatment * preferred_party_ptv_dummy + lead_time + party,
  data = data_federal_ptv_noexcl
)
m_pref_ptv_ties_federal_noexcl <- lm(list_votes_exp_diff ~ treatment * preferred_party_ptv_dummy_ties + lead_time + party,
  data = data_federal_ptvties_noexcl
)
m_pref_vi_federal_noexcl <- lm(list_votes_exp_diff ~ treatment * preferred_party_vi_dummy + lead_time + party,
  data = data_federal_vi_noexcl
)
m_pref_pid_federal_noexcl <- lm(list_votes_exp_diff ~ treatment * preferred_party_pid_dummy + lead_time + party,
  data = data_federal_pid_noexcl
)
m_pref_ptv_score_federal_noexcl <- lm(list_votes_exp_diff ~ treatment * ptv_score + lead_time + party,
  data = data_federal_ptvscore_noexcl
)

write_models_table( # helper
  models = list(
    m_time_full_federal_noexcl, m_mae_full_federal_noexcl, m_rmse_full_federal_noexcl,
    m_pref_ptv_federal_noexcl, m_pref_ptv_ties_federal_noexcl, m_pref_vi_federal_noexcl,
    m_pref_pid_federal_noexcl, m_pref_ptv_score_federal_noexcl
  ),
  header = header_models,
  model_names = labels_models,
  groups = groups_models,
  coef_map = coef_map_federal,
  cluster_idx = 4:8,
  caption = "Linear Regression Models for the Federal Election Without Exclusions",
  label = "tab:models_federal_noexcl",
  note = "Note: * p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001. Same models as Table~\\ref{tab:models_federal}, but including those respondents who answered 50\\% twice.",
  file = "output/tables/table_C5_models_noexcl_federal.tex"
)
```

## Main Sample vs. No Exclusions (Figure C.7a)

H1 without exclusions, transformed to seconds as in Figure 2.

```{r figure_C7a, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
set.seed(20250223)
m_time_full_federal_avg_case_sim_noexcl <- simloglm(m_time_full_federal_noexcl, scenario = list(
  treatment = c("Control", "Treatment (5)", "Treatment (500)"),
  baseline_speed = mean(data_federal_time_noexcl_nooutliers$baseline_speed),
  duration = mean(data_federal_time_noexcl_nooutliers$duration),
  lead_time = "15"
))
time_median_federal_noexcl <- compute_time_effects(m_time_full_federal_avg_case_sim_noexcl, "median", time_diffs_federal) # helper

treatments_federal <- c("Control", "Treatment (5)", "Treatment (500)")
noexcl_comparison_federal <- list(
  compute_sample_effects_time(
    m_time_full_federal_avg_case_sim, treatments_federal, # helper
    time_median_federal$diff, "Main", "H1: Response Time (s, median)"
  ),
  compute_sample_effects_time(
    m_time_full_federal_avg_case_sim_noexcl, treatments_federal, # helper
    time_median_federal_noexcl$diff, "No excl.", "H1: Response Time (s, median)"
  ),
  compute_sample_effects(m_mae_full_federal, data_federal_main, "Main", "H2: MAE"), # helper
  compute_sample_effects(m_mae_full_federal_noexcl, data_federal_noexcl, "No excl.", "H2: MAE"), # helper
  compute_sample_effects(m_pref_ptv_federal, data_federal_ptv_main, "Main", "H3: Forecast Error (PTV)", # helper
    by = "preferred_party_ptv_dummy", vcov = ~ResponseId
  ),
  compute_sample_effects(m_pref_ptv_federal_noexcl, data_federal_ptv_noexcl, "No excl.", "H3: Forecast Error (PTV)", # helper
    by = "preferred_party_ptv_dummy", vcov = ~ResponseId
  )
)

fd_noexcl_federal <- map_dfr(noexcl_comparison_federal, "diff") %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = factor(outcome, levels = sample_outcome_levels)
  )
print_values(fd_noexcl_federal, c("outcome", "diff", "sample", est_cols)) # helper

plot_noexcl_fd_federal <- plot_sample_diff(fd_noexcl_federal) # helper
plot_noexcl_fd_federal
save_figure(plot_noexcl_fd_federal, "figure_C7a_h123_noexcl_fd_federal",
  election = "federal", # helper
  width = "full", aspect = 8 / 12
)
```
